name: Read-tool output and authorization probes
description: Explicit synthetic resource reads through the gateway, including a known resource expected to be denied.
limitations: Use dedicated synthetic resources. These probes execute the configured read provider and cannot verify that its declared read protocol has no side effects.
The target is the tool alias in the plan. This does not cover all Agent tools, model decisions or external execution routes.
Every category must actually be observed, and a benign exact response plus before-execution resource denial must be verified.
Suite resource identifiers and expected literals are retained. Returned probe text is not retained, even when retain_responses is enabled.

cases.title: Deny the known restricted resource before execution
